craftgpt.ui.workflow_help:
1. Mark two opposite corners with the CraftBook.

2. Describe the object you want and choose Build with Codex.

3. Close the progress screen to keep playing. Chat and Activity show progress.

4. Inspect the preview, then Place or Request changes.

Tools contain versions, API planning, import and recovery. All existing commands remain available.
